title: Why is SAM Robust to Label Noise?
mechanism: SAM's label-noise robustness comes mainly from a network-Jacobian regularisation effect and peaks with early stopping; cheaper explicit regularisers recover much of it.
adaptation: Mechanism reason for the SAM arm on jittered crack labels; if SAM helps, test the cheaper explicit regulariser at 1x cost and read earlier checkpoints.
evidence: SAM gains of tens of percent under label noise; peak before convergence (abstract).
min_experiment: Conditional on SAM: explicit-regulariser arm vs PF+SAM, seeds 5-9; kill if below PF+SAM on test relF1@2.
